notes.title: Update Patch Version 1.8
notes.content:
In the latest patch Planetarium 2 - Zen Odyssey brings you 5 new simulations scenes to enjoy with more coming soon in future updates!

View the relative scale and  size of stars! Compare Neptune, Uranus, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Earth, Venus, Mercury, Sol, Sirius, Vega, Pollux, Arcturus, Rigel, Aldebaren, Betelgeuse and Vy Canis Majoris.

notes.title: Update Patch Version 1.7
notes.content:
In the latest patch Planetarium 2 - Zen Odyssey brings you 5 new simulations scenes to enjoy with more coming soon in future updates!

Have a closer look at an solar eclipse!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/bca6d5d036ecd9730c6f11fdd99023de9b84fff4.png[/img]

New galaxy to be viewed. The Cartwheel Galaxy is a lenticular galaxy and ring galaxy about 500 million light-years away in the constellation Sculptor. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/4df9bb095012fa1fec57fc7ac244d6bd3e05f666.png[/img]

New galaxy to be viewed. AM 0644-741, also known as the Lindsay-Shapley Ring, is an unbarred lenticular galaxy, and a ring galaxy, which is 300 million light-years away in the southern constellation Volans.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/f96a5c3912858f0faa459987356f8b3f19bbbaad.png[/img]

New galaxy to be viewed. Sombrero Galaxy is an elliptical galaxy in the constellation Virgo located 9.55 Mpc from Earth.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/034a2e289ccabf6fd066eab3fe3305e4cd7258bc.png[/img]

Get an closer look at the moons of Jupiter!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/6556c5494aa90e566d2966080f1ed7488d0986e2.png[/img]

New scene with five new orbiting satellites. The Apollo-Soyuz, Shenzhou, Evisat, Corot and the Splitzer satellite.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/b001f470da4dc11ef974b5a4b3a3a47f9ac0c04f.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/8637ad20223207b5a132dea60136b38913d47f1b.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/50bcdfdcda0284b2ceeb2c7483b3c20945e27dd3.png[/img]

Become the Starman and voyage through the solar system!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/f5f28410180b44ecde97543e28f5080d5addb1b8.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/529b6148886f95284f74ccdc10d336dc8ce133b0.png[/img]

I hope to improve Planetarium 2 Zen Odyssey with your feedback in mind.

Hope you enjoy this update with more coming soon!

Thank you very much for all your support!

notes.title: Update Patch Version 1.6
notes.content:
In the latest patch Planetarium 2 - Zen Odyssey brings you 5 new simulations scenes to enjoy with more coming soon in future updates!

[b]View the Exosolar System Gliese 876 and its orbiting exoplanets. Gliese 876 is a red dwarf approximately 15 light-years away from Earth in the constellation of Aquarius.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/0d28f1619909e26593712fd4bdb15f11305253e5.png[/img]

[b]View the 51 Pegasi, also named Helvetios, is a Sun-like star located 50.9 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Pegasus. [/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/9ef0c7382433e34852d857adf1ac7c3f5320cd2c.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/7cec78687b7ba254fdc8f0cceba2b9ab45b6c76d.png[/img]

[b]Pilot the Apollo Lunar Module with new detailed cockpit view![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/fad95e9eb97abecb4abb008ba90666518017fc9a.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Patch Version 1.4
notes.content:
In the latest patch Planetarium 2 - Zen Odyssey brings you 5 new simulations scenes to enjoy with more coming soon in future updates!

[b]Control and launch the Apollo LLRV! The Bell Aerosystems Lunar Landing Research Vehicle was an Project Apollo era program to build a simulator for the Moon landings.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/c10dff626220853e882d2684c19c8f809c58f440.png[/img]

[b]View the beauty of our Earth from the ISS Observation Cupola! Toggle the doors to immerse yourself in first-person. [/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/e435b26206a18877bb60be79a9fd682a0a691d3e.png[/img]

[b]Experience zero gravity and immerse yourself inside the ISS in first-person.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/a6ae53f173594a6944be319b398ee17bfca7dbc8.png[/img]

[b]New scene including a city scape that can be destroyed by launching asteroids from space! [/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/61957ccc2efb48d77b6d6c101d6248f3e9266fc5.png[/img]

[b]Get hot and close to the sun and experience scorching heat from solar flares![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/7dcde0ffcafb6c1c2c7ff9da52801a39700946d2.png[/img]

New button has been added on the title screen to access simulations quickly and easily. I hope to improve Planetarium 2 Zen Odyssey with your feedback in mind.

Hope you enjoy this update with more coming soon!

Thank you very much for all your support!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/a6ae53f173594a6944be319b398ee17bfca7dbc8.png[/img]

[b]New scene including a city scape that can be destroyed by launching asteroids from space! [/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/61957ccc2efb48d77b6d6c101d6248f3e9266fc5.png[/img]

[b]Get hot and close to the sun and experience scorching heat from solar flares![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/7dcde0ffcafb6c1c2c7ff9da52801a39700946d2.png[/img]

New button has been added on the title screen to access simulations quickly and easily. I hope to improve Planetarium 2 Zen Odyssey with your feedback in mind.

Hope you enjoy this update with more coming soon!

Thank you very much for all your support!

notes.title: Update Patch Version 1.2
notes.content:
In the latest patch Planetarium 2 - Zen Odyssey brings you 5 new simulations scenes to enjoy with more coming soon in future updates!

[b]View the 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko comet and the Rosetta Probe![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/b9e3e970b9ab4095c17629eb15dc426a50ffddf6.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/dd6c012ab2ad5b709a91dfbe7338fbcc09b6f8e8.png[/img]

[b]An interesting observation...Fidget Spinner in space? Change its colours by using the search icon![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/5db6b3f97d718c81bef21cddb930ef042ee27dec.png[/img]

[b] View the Mariner-10 and Magellan space probes![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/8302756d75d7ffbbf66c91f223ef9331c634edac.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/8939328d7c970575e00783940f0df2f194c82fb0.png[/img]

[b]New scene giving you a closer look at the International Space Station! [/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/9e16f96e1c684605431729c31b37bea0c4ca4189.png[/img]

[b]New scene giving you a closer look at Uranus and its various moons![/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31442257/ad1bf6dba08d0f22ef98a7a66ffd82601b7ad7ae.png[/img]

Finally reading your feedback I have now increased the time the UI fades out when inactive. This caused some frustration when reading the instructions!

Speaking of instructions many players accidently skipped them and had no way of viewing them again. The title screen now allows you to reset the tutorial so you can view the instructions again whenever you want!

Graphical errors in Gravitional Waves scene and when toggling the grid in the solar system scenes have now been fixed.

Hope you enjoy this update with more coming soon!

Thank you very much for all your support!
